newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Baycorp exits telemarketing joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Baycorp exits telemarketing joint venture.

text.p: Baycorp Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had sold its half stake in the joint venture telemarketing business BAYTEL Ltd.

"While the business has not been unsuccessful, the joint venture has not provided the benefits to Baycorp, or its partners, sought and as a result, Baycorp has elected to exit the business by sale of its interests to the U.S. partners," Baycorp said. No price was disclosed.
It said it would continue to offer telephony solutions to its clients aligned to its core activity in the areas of database management and financial services.
